title: Setup: build Apache POI's poi module at both #1420 revisions and run TestDataFormatter (rerun, jar path fixed)
description: Setup for case B of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-composition-ff/worktrees (B-poi-fix = bd15f5bc, B-poi-parent = 6b277ffc), builds :poi:jar with the upstream Gradle 9.8.1 wrapper on JDK 17.0.21 (toolchain 17, auto-download off), --offline: the setup session resolved every :poi configuration online first into the cache's gradle-home. Runs each side's own TestDataFormatter, then the landed file transplanted onto the parent, where the new tests are expected to fail (the transplant is restored after). Jars to .../artifacts with sha256, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: TestDataFormatter passes on both sides' own tests; the transplanted landed test has failures on the parent

steps.name: B-poi-fix: :poi:jar, TestDataFormatter (landed)
B-poi-parent: :poi:jar, its own TestDataFormatter

steps.run: set -euo pipefail; O=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-composition-ff; W=$O/worktrees; export TMPDIR=$O/tmp GRADLE_USER_HOME=$O/gradle-home; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; git -C $W/B-poi-fix clean -fdxq; git -C $W/B-poi-parent clean -fdxq; du -sh $W
